task_text: Process quotation Q-1042: read it, check stock internally to inform the procurement decision, and acknowledge receipt to the vendor at sales@shakti.example by email.

   - 9mm brass casings: 500 units @ INR 120
   - Field radio batteries: 200 units @ INR 850

args.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

Thank you for submitting Quotation Q-1042 dated today. We have received your offer for:

- 9mm brass casings: 500 units @ INR 120

We will revert with a decision within the validity period.

Regards,
Procurement Office
